text: CONTRADICTING: In independent experiments, ApoE4 particles again decreased LysoTracker-positive puncta number compared with untreated astrocytes, and also decreased puncta size (Fig S5A-B). Treatments meant to increase endolysosomal acidity (rimeporide, YM-201636) restored LysoTracker puncta. This implies ApoE4 causes an acidification deficit rather than lower pH. Class 5 because the perturbation adds re-acidifying drugs on top of ApoE4 vs no particle, with no ApoE3 comparator.
description: Primary hippocampal astrocytes from wild-type Sprague-Dawley rats. Treated in HBSS for 4 h with 50 µg/ml ApoE4/POPC particles ± 10 µM rimeporide or ± 200 nM YM-201636, with 50 nM LysoTracker Red for the last 30 min. n = 8 independent experiments (rimeporide) and n = 4 (YM-201636). Caveat: no ApoE3 comparator in this experiment; rat cells; LysoTracker is a surrogate for acidification; drug effects are not specific to endosomes.

provenance.excerpt: Here, we found that both rimeporide and YM-201636 rescued the ApoE4-mediated decrease in LysoTracker-positive puncta in astrocytes (Figures 5A-5D, S5A and S5B).
